claim: Commercial EUV lithography uses radiation around 13.5 nm.
High-NA EUV raises numerical aperture from 0.33 to 0.55.
ZEISS reports that the High-NA illumination system contains more than 25,000 parts and weighs over six tons.
ZEISS reports more than 40,000 parts in High-NA projection optics, weighing around twelve tons.
ASML describes High-NA EXE anamorphic optics as demagnifying the reticle pattern 4x in one direction and 8x in the other, resulting in an exposure field half the size of NXE.

A published ASML patent application describes a lithographic apparatus with an illuminator, reflective patterning device, substrate table and reflective projection system for EUV use.
